courses.title: EmDash CMS: From First Look to Production
courses.description: Five hands-on videos covering EmDash CMS end to end — what it is, how it compares to WordPress, building custom themes with AI agents, deploying free on Cloudflare Workers, sending email, and a self-hosted Docker install with benchmarks.

lessons.title: WordPress Is Broken. Can EmDash Replace It? (Full Hands-On)
lessons.description: A full hands-on look at EmDash CMS — what it is, how it compares to WordPress, and whether it can replace a WordPress stack for real projects.

lessons.title: EmDash CMS Custom Themes: From Design to Database with AI Agents
lessons.description: Build a custom EmDash theme end to end with AI agents — from the design pass all the way to wiring it to the database.

lessons.title: Deploy EmDash on Cloudflare Workers for FREE (Step-by-Step)
lessons.description: Deploy EmDash on Cloudflare Workers for free, step by step — Workers, D1, and the config needed to go live.

lessons.title: How to Send Emails in EmDash CMS (Cloudflare & Free SMTP Guide)
lessons.description: Set up transactional email in EmDash — both on Cloudflare and with free SMTP providers.

lessons.title: Is Self-Hosted EmDash Faster? Benchmarks + Complete Docker Setup
lessons.description: Self-host EmDash with Docker — the complete setup, plus benchmarks against the Cloudflare Workers deploy.

courses.title: Dokploy: Self-Host Your Own PaaS
courses.description: Five videos to run Dokploy like a production PaaS — secure VPS setup, remote servers, monitoring with Uptime Kuma and Beszel, a real PostgreSQL + TanStack deploy, and a backup strategy that actually works.

lessons.title: Host Your Own Apps Like a Pro! Dokploy Setup + VPS Security Guide
lessons.description: Install Dokploy on a VPS and lock it down — the complete setup for hosting your own apps securely.

lessons.title: How to Setup a Dokploy Remote Server
lessons.description: Attach a remote server to Dokploy and deploy apps to it from your main panel.

lessons.title: Monitor Your Dokploy Server Like a Pro: Uptime Kuma + Beszel Setup!
lessons.description: Monitor your Dokploy server with Uptime Kuma and Beszel — uptime alerts plus live server metrics.

lessons.title: Host Your Database & App Like a Pro — PostgreSQL + TanStack on Dokploy!
lessons.description: Deploy a real app stack on Dokploy: a PostgreSQL database plus a TanStack app wired to it.

lessons.title: Stop LOSING Your Data — Dokploy Backup Strategy That ACTUALLY Works
lessons.description: A Dokploy backup strategy that actually works — what to back up, where to put it, and how to restore.
